jobs.title: SAP BRIM Consultant, Director
jobs.description:
As a SAP BRIM Consultant, Director, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize their operational efficiency through specialized consulting services for SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) applications. You will analyze client requirements, implement CRM software solutions, and provide training and support to facilitate seamless integration and utilization of SAP CRM applications. Within our Advisory practice, you will enable clients to enhance customer relationship management processes and achieve their strategic objectives.
  

  

As a Director, you will set the strategic direction and lead business development efforts, making impactful decisions while overseeing multiple projects. You will maintain executive\-level client relations, translating vision into actionable strategies and inspiring others to follow. Your role is crucial in driving business growth, shaping client engagements, and mentoring the next generation of leaders. You are expected to uphold PwC's reputation for quality, integrity, and inclusion, fostering an environment where people and technology thrive together. In this role, you will identify market gaps and convert opportunities into successes for the firm, promoting technological advances and creating a healthy working environment that maximizes client satisfaction.
  

  

Responsibilities
  

  

* Leading strategic direction and business development efforts for SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) applications
* Analyzing client requirements to implement CRM software solutions that optimize customer relationship management processes
* Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of SAP CRM applications
* Driving business growth by identifying market gaps and converting opportunities into success for the firm
* Mentoring the next generation of leaders and fostering a collaborative environment across the PwC Network
* Promoting technological advances and creating environments where people and technology thrive together
* Developing new ideas, solutions, and structures to drive thought leadership and innovation
* Balancing long\-term, short\-term, detail\-oriented, and big picture thinking to make strategic choices and drive change
* Cultivating potential in others and maintaining executive\-level client relations to maximize client satisfaction

  

What You Must Have
  

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 8 years of experience

  

What Sets You Apart
  

  

* Preference for a Master's or Masters of Business Administration degree in at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems
* Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Cloud for Customer and SAP CRM
* Utilizing strategic mindset for business process improvement
* Leading customer transformation initiatives with CRM software
* Excelling in business technology and systemic thinking
* Driving innovation through rapid experimentation and creativity
* Cultivating customer engagement and relationship management skills

The salary range for this position is: $155,000 \- $410,000\. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. jobs.title: Flexible Consumption Billing Implementation Manager
jobs.description:

We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.
   

  

 Recruiting for this role ends on December 31, 2026
   

  

**Work You'll Do**
 As a Manager, Flexible Consumption Billing Implementation, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Working on integrated project teams on a range of projects covering the entire lifecycle from strategy formulation through to design, development and the deployment of solutions.
* Bringing considerable billing management expertise to help design, develop and implement subscription billing solutions to transform client's billing processes.
* Interacting daily with key business and IT executives
* Leading multiple teams in various strategy and implementation activities.
* Providing service excellence by identifying key client business issues
* Determining client needs by supplementing the standard assessment techniques and tools with innovative approaches
* Evaluating and validate analysis and developing recommendations for the client in the context of the overall engagement
* Implementing and overseeing the quality of deliverables and effectively manage the team and day\-to\-day relationships to ensure exceptional performance.


 The successful Manager you will possess:
   

  

* Strong communication skills \- ability to communicate complex system concepts to a business audience in a clear and concise manner
* Ability to facilitate clients' most complex business requirements
* Knowledge of basic accounting policies, and implications
* Experience identifying creative solutions within configurable cloud systems or within boundary applications where customization is required
* Leadership \- proven ability to lead complex engagements, both business and technical, including multiple dependencies and integration points
* Problem solving and troubleshooting skills with the ability to exercise mature judgment


**The Team**
 Our Sales \& Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 8\+ years experience in subscription billing within consulting or industry, specifically focused on delivering cloud\-based subscription billing solutions
* 5\+ years experience with end\-to\-end implementations of Subscription Billing solutions (e.g. Zuora Billing, Oracle NetSuite, SAP BRIM)
* Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
* A Bachelor's degree


 Preferred:
   

  

* Minimum 4 years of experience designing or optimizing lead\-to\-cash and record\-to\-report processes and end\-to\-end architectures.
* 4\+ years of direct experience across all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including Design, Build, Quality Assurance (QA), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Support.
* 4\+ years of practical experience applying Agile and Scrum methodologies to deliver technology or business solutions.
* 4\+ years of experience conducting architecture assessments and developing implementation roadmaps for subscription billing solutions.
* 4\+ years of experience designing and configuring cloud or SaaS\-based billing solutions in complex, multi\-entity environments.
* 3\+ years of experience designing integrations with upstream systems (such as Ordering, Provisioning) and downstream ERP applications (such as General Ledger)
* Minimum 1 year of experience managing teams of 5 or more people, including responsibility for performance, deliverables, and team development.


 The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $ 134,500 \- $265,100\.
   

  

 You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: SAP FICO Analyst / Business Analyst

 This individual will work closely with business stakeholders, finance teams, technical resources, and project leadership to gather requirements, improve financial processes, troubleshoot system issues, and ensure SAP solutions align with business objectives.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Configure, maintain, and support SAP FICO modules to meet business and financial reporting requirements.

* Create and maintain functional documentation, process flows, configuration records, and end\-user training materials.

 Required Qualifications
 


* **5–7 years of hands\-on SAP FICO configuration and support experience** 
 , including financial accounting and controlling processes.

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with functional, technical, and business teams in an enterprise environment.



  





 Work Arrangement
 


* Hybrid position based out of

 .
* Local candidates should expect to work onsite approximately
 **2 days per week** 
 .
* Highly qualified candidates outside the local commuting area may be considered for an alternative arrangement requiring approximately

 .

jobs.title: SAP BRIM TECHNICAL CONSULTANT
jobs.description:
SAP BRIM Technical Consultant
   

  

 Summary
   

 We are seeking a highly skilled SAP BRIM Technical Consultant to join our IT Services team. In this pivotal role, you will leverage your expertise in SAP Business Relationship and Revenue Management to drive technical implementation and integration efforts. The position demands a professional capable of bridging complex business requirements with robust technical solutions, ensuring seamless data flow and system performance across the enterprise landscape. This role is essential for optimizing revenue management processes and supporting critical business operations within our dynamic technology environment.
   

  

 Responsibilities
   

* Design and develop technical integrations between SAP HANA and S/4HANA environments to ensure data consistency and operational efficiency.
* Engineer and maintain custom forms using both SmartForms and Adobe Forms solutions to meet specific reporting and document generation needs.
* Utilize Eclipse ADT and SAP GUI for effective development, debugging, and maintenance of application components.
* Contribute to the modernization of user interfaces by implementing SAP BTP Fiori and UI5 applications where applicable.
* Develop and enhance core business logic using SAP ABAP and Object\-Oriented ABAP methodologies.
* Implement system extensions and modifications through the Enhancement Framework, including the creation of BAdIs and User Exits.
* Configure and support key SAP BRIM modules, specifically Sales Order Management (SOM), Convergent Charging (CC), Convergent Invoicing (CI), and FI\-CA, to facilitate accurate billing and revenue recognition.


 Requirements
   

  

**Requirements:**
* Possess a minimum of 3 years and a maximum of 6 years of professional work experience in SAP technical roles.
* Demonstrate proven proficiency in SAP HANA and S/4HANA integration patterns.
* Show strong command over form development tools, specifically SmartForms and Adobe Forms.
* Be well\-versed in development environments such as Eclipse ADT and SAP GUI.
* Exhibit a solid understanding of SAP ABAP and Object\-Oriented ABAP programming principles.
* Have hands\-on experience with the Enhancement Framework, including BAdIs and User Exits.
* Display specialized knowledge of the SAP BRIM suite, with a focus on SOM, Convergent Charging, Convergent Invoicing, and FI\-CA.
* Familiarity with SAP BTP, Fiori, and UI5 is considered a valuable asset.
